test_janus_processor_chat_template_singl: test the JanusProcessor chat template with a single user message containing text and an image
test_janus_processor_chat_template_batch: test the JanusProcessor chat template with a batch of messages containing multiple images per conversation
test_janus_processor_chat_template_kwarg: test the JanusProcessor chat template with padding, truncation, and image rescaling kwargs
test_janus_processor_postprocess: test the JanusProcessor postprocess method to unnormalize pixel values back to original image inputs
